bankName: Factory Demo Starter Bank v4 - Bass Crunch Vocal Acoustic-Synth Guide
purpose: Human-readable implementation guide for factory-style presets. This is not intended to be a direct synth preset import format. v4 includes v3 bass/crunch/vocal coverage plus violin, piano, and xylophone-style synthetic acoustic demo patches.

custom_wavetable.description: Either oscillator can have its own independent A/B/C/D frame set when set to custom mode.

modulationMatrixConventions.targetNaming: Descriptive dot paths are used here for readability. Map these to internal parameter IDs during implementation.

customWavetable.name: Scanner Metal A
customWavetable.character: dark triangle to metallic noisy harmonic frames

customWavetable.name: Scanner Air B

patches.name: Concrete Reese
patches.intent: Wide distorted mid-bass with moving wavetable grit and compressed weight.

customWavetable.name: Concrete Grit Table
customWavetable.character: saw-like bass frames moving from dense midrange into folded abrasive harmonics

implementationNotes: Use mono/legato/glide behavior for bassline playability.
For implementation, consider forcing low-frequency output mono or keeping spread narrower below the sub range.

patches.name: Bit Jaw
patches.intent: Aggressive bitcrushed lead/bass patch for hard hooks and glitch riffs.
implementationNotes: The macro.color modulation reduces bit depth while increasing distortion drive, so higher macro values should feel more broken and aggressive.
The patch can work as either a lead or upper bass; transpose down one octave for heavier bass demos.

patches.name: Vowel Choir
patches.intent: Slow morphing synthetic choir pad using ABCD frames as vowel-like positions.

customWavetable.name: OO AH EH EE Choir Table
customWavetable.character: four vowel-like frames designed for slow oscillator position scanning

implementationNotes: ABCD frames are intended as synthetic vowel anchors rather than realistic sample vowels.
The slow LFO position scan is the main vocal movement source; macro.shape should manually sweep the vowel position.

patches.name: Talk Pluck
patches.intent: Short talking pluck where the mod envelope scans across vowel-like wavetable frames.

customWavetable.name: WA AH YAH EE Talk Table
customWavetable.character: short vowel movement for plucks and talking synth gestures

implementationNotes: The mod envelope should quickly sweep oscA.position across A/B/C/D to create a talking attack.
oneShot LFO 1 can add a second repeatable mini-scan when retriggered per note.

patches.name: Resin Violin Lead
patches.intent: Violin-inspired sustained lead using a bowed/string-like custom wavetable, slow attack, vibrato, and expressive macro/aftertouch control. It is meant as a stylized synth string, not a realistic sampled violin.

customWavetable.name: Bowed Rosin Table
customWavetable.character: warm bowed body through brighter rosin-edge frames for violin-like nasal motion

implementationNotes: This patch uses vibrato, legato, and slow timbre movement to suggest a bowed string. Without a noise source, body resonator, or physical-modeling bow interaction, it should be presented as synth violin/string lead rather than realistic violin.
For better realism later, add a noise/bow source, a keytracked resonator/comb filter, and per-oscillator envelopes.

patches.name: Block Felt Piano
patches.intent: Soft piano-like key patch for Minecraft-style ambient music: dark body, short bright attack, long decay, and roomy reverb. This is a synthetic approximation, not a sampled piano.

customWavetable.name: Soft Harmonic Hammer Table
customWavetable.character: dark body to thin bright attack frame, intended for fast envelope scanning at note onset

modulationMatrix.purpose: start brighter and quickly settle into darker body
harder notes get more attack/hammer partials

implementationNotes: The fake-piano identity comes from fast envelope scanning of a bright oscillator into a darker body, plus velocity to brightness and attack amount.
A real piano still benefits from samples or physical modeling, but this is useful for stylized, soft, ambient, or Minecraft-like piano cues.

patches.name: Toy Xylophone
patches.intent: Synthetic xylophone / wooden mallet patch with short decay, harmonic attack table, velocity brightness, and small room ambience.

customWavetable.name: Wood Bar Harmonics Table
customWavetable.character: short bright mallet/bar harmonics moving from rounded body to clicky upper partials

modulationMatrix.purpose: brief bright transient, then lower body frame

implementationNotes: The xylophone patch relies on short amp decay, bright transient scanning, high keytrack, and velocity to attack brightness.
For more realistic mallets later, add per-oscillator envelopes or a small click/noise transient source.

patches.name: Benchmark - Future Bass Strings
patches.intent: Bright, animated future-bass string and supersaw hybrid with a saw-plus-square oscillator stack, tempo-synced amplitude and filter motion, chorus, phaser, saturation, delay, and bright room ambience.
patches.auditionNote: Audition syncopated four-note chords from C3 through C5; the pumping motion should remain audible while attacks stay smooth and the upper octave avoids brittle aliasing.

patches.name: Benchmark - Progressive House Strings
patches.intent: Warm, sustained progressive-house string pad built from layered saw oscillators, moderate unison, slow filter bloom, chorus, saturation, compression, and a large room.
patches.auditionNote: Audition held triads from C2 through C5 and overlapping chord changes; the swell should stay warm, wide, coherent, and free of clicks across long releases.

addedInV3: Talk Pluck - short talking formant pluck
implementationNotes: Bass and crunchy patches use only available FX: High-pass, Low-pass, Saturator, Distortion, Bitcrush, Flanger, Delay, Compressor.
Vocal patches treat custom wavetable frames A/B/C/D as vowel-like positions and use the modulation matrix to scan oscillator position.
The JSON uses descriptive target paths for implementation mapping; it is not a direct preset import schema.

The v4 acoustic-style patches are intentionally synthetic approximations. They use wavetable/frame scanning, envelope-controlled brightness, velocity modulation, and room/chorus processing rather than samples.
For stronger acoustic realism later, prioritize per-oscillator amp envelopes, a noise/click transient source, keytracked resonator/comb filtering, and velocity curves.

optionalFutureFeatures.feature: clean sub path or mono-low-band routing
optionalFutureFeatures.benefit: Lets heavy bass patches distort and widen mids while preserving a stable mono sub.
Makes vocal patches easier and more predictable than shaping formants only inside the custom wavetable frames.
Adds realism and transient detail for choir, talkbox, wind, pluck, and vocal-like patches.
